description.zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an instance ID exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If no instance ID exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页。取值范围1~10,000，默认值为1。
description.en: Specifies the page number of the return result to display. Valid values: 1 to 10,000. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 指定每页返回的语料条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20。
description.en: Specifies the number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 10.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
